messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A stout four-legged creature shown in right-side profile walking to the right, with a broad flat pale pink amphibian-like head, small dark eyes, a wide mouth and small nostrils, and feathery pink stalked external gills behind the head. Its throat, chest, belly, legs and underside of the tail are pale pinkish-white wrinkled skin, while the entire back from behind the head to the tip of its long tapering tail is covered in overlapping large dark brown to gray rounded scales. It stands on four thick fleshy limbs ending in clawed toes.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat pale pink axolotl-like head with rounded snout, wide mouth and speckled skin", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body facing right"}, {"looks_like": "small round black eyes with pale rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "wide straight slit-like mouth", "part": "mouth", "where": "across the lower front of the head below the snout"}, {"looks_like": "small pink dot-like nostril", "part": "nose", "where": "on the tip of the snout"}, {"looks_like": "pink stalked feathery tufts with fine filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "three on each side of the head just behind the eyes"}, {"looks_like": "thick stout pale pink wrinkled limbs", "part": "legs", "where": "two under the front chest and two under the rear hips"}, {"looks_like": "broad splayed toes with small dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering fleshy tail pale below and scaled above", "part": "tail", "where": "extending back from the rear of the body to the left edge of the picture"}, {"looks_like": "large overlapping rounded dark brown to gray keratin plates", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the entire back and top of the tail from behind the gills to the tail tip"}, {"looks_like": "pale pinkish-white soft skin with ringed wrinkles and folds", "part": "skin", "where": "on the throat, chest, belly, legs and underside of the tail"}, {"looks_like": "small gray speckles", "part": "markings", "where": "scattered on the top and sides of the head"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
